title:
TapeOut Protocol
Intelligence Terminal
subtitle: A public-source analytics surface for processor creation, mint completion and circuit activity. Protocol totals begin at TapeOut Day 1 from zero; the monitor updates independently from the Registry.
methodCopy: Protocol totals use the TapeOut Day 1 zero baseline. D1 snapshot history begins later and only describes this monitor's observed trajectory; data is observed, not projected.

learnIntroCopy: TapeOut turns NAND and LATCH components into browser-designed Circuits and Processors. This path separates free Canvas experimentation from wallet-confirmed, irreversible on-chain actions.
learnMapCanvasBody: Use the Canvas before any signature
learnMapPodBody: Eligibility and verification are not returns
learnPathTitle: Six steps from concept to an informed action
learnPathDescription: Finish a step before moving forward. Canvas experiments are not on-chain transactions; signing a wallet request is.
learnStep1Body: NAND and LATCH are components. A Processor is the public design container. A Circuit is the on-chain result after tape-out. $BEM Proof of Design is a separate design-verification domain.
learnStep2Title: Start only from official entry points
learnStep2Body: Open TapeOut from the official site. Do not copy addresses from a private message, search ad or group chat.
learnStep3Body: Use an official example to connect gates and inspect the behavior. This stage does not require a wallet transaction.
learnStep4Title: Read the tape-out cost before signing
learnStep4Body: Tape-out consumes selected components and the transaction is irreversible. Recheck network, wallet, gas, inputs, outputs and displayed cost.
learnStep5Title: Choose the mechanism you actually want
learnStep5Body: Processor creation, Circuit design, market trading and Proof of Design are different activities with different costs and conditions.
learnStep6Title: Treat outcome claims as claims, not facts
learnStep6Body: Creator mint income depends on future minting; PoD depends on eligibility and verification; quoted market prices may not be executable. None is guaranteed.
learnSafetyDescription: Market price, creator mint income and PoD output are different mechanisms. None guarantees a positive outcome.
learnSafety1: Confirm you are on the official TapeOut URL and the intended BNB Chain network.
learnSafety2: Read the wallet request and displayed component/gas cost; stop if it differs from your intent.
learnSafety3: Never reveal a private key or seed phrase. The platform should not ask for either.
learnSafety4: Treat market quotes as quotes, not guaranteed exit prices; shallow liquidity can move quickly.
learnSafety5: Check current upgradeability and public rule status before treating any contract behavior as final.
learnSafetyLink: Read community market Q&A · not official rules ↗
learnResourcesDescription: Each resource is visibly classified as Official, Community or Concept Reference. Community content does not inherit official status; return-promising and private-message material is excluded.
learnResourceNoData: No reviewed public resource matches this filter.
learnCommunityNote: Community explanation · official sources prevail for mechanics
learnReferenceNote: Concept reference · not a TapeOut Protocol operating guide
updatesDescription: This is an audited public-content flow, not real-time X ingestion. Every card keeps its source URL, author or operator, source tier and risk boundary.
updatesNoData: No reviewed public update matches this filter.
toolsDescription: Each tool is included for a stated practical use and an explicit safety boundary. Community and reference tools never inherit official status.
toolsNoData: No reviewed tool matches this filter.
holderDescription: A free, source-selected TapeOut Club community leaderboard. It shows only ranked processor rows, not a complete transistor-holder census; addresses are never attributed to real-world people, LPs, routers or investors.
holderStale: Community snapshot stale · showing last successful data
holderPending: Community processor board is awaiting its first verified public snapshot.
holderEstimateOnly: community estimate · not a return promise
holderBoundary: Source boundary: community estimate only. Not an official TapeOut API, not a full holder list, and absence from this board is not evidence of zero ownership.
apiCommunityBoard: Source-selected public processor addresses, coverage and previous-snapshot changes from a community estimate. It is not an official or complete holder list.
officialAssetDescription: Official public snapshots for TapeOut, Behemoth and Genesis CPU only. Holder counts are aggregate; cumulative mint addresses and open bids are separate address observations, not current wallet balances.
officialAssetStale: Official snapshot delayed · showing last successful data
officialAssetPending: Official three-project snapshot is awaiting its first verified read.
officialAssetMinterNotHolder: Cumulative mint address · not current holding
officialAssetNoAddresses: No official cumulative mint addresses are available in the verified snapshot.
officialAssetBoundary: Boundary: TapeOut, Behemoth and Genesis CPU only. Official CPU stats disclose aggregate holder counts and cumulative mint addresses; official market stats disclose open bids. Neither provides a full current address-by-address NAND/LATCH balance list, so no address is labelled as an investor, LP, router or current holder.
apiOfficialAssets: Official TapeOut, Behemoth and Genesis CPU aggregate holder/minter/order observations. Cumulative minters and open bids are never current balances.
mechanicsTitle: Read the mechanism before you act
mechanicsIntro: This is a guided reading of specific public TapeOut pages—not a whitepaper, return forecast or investment recommendation. Follow the source links before any wallet action.
mechanicsPrimitivesCopy: TapeOut describes NAND as the basic logic element and LATCH as the state cell. Together they are the public starting point for circuits and processors.
mechanicsCanvasCopy: Canvas experiments run in the browser. The official site describes a Tape Out as the on-chain step where transistors are burned and a Circuit NFT is created.
mechanicsProcessorCopy: Supply, mint price and the stated revenue split are set at creation. The official site also discloses that protocol contracts remain upgradeable before a formal freeze.
mechanicsPodCopy: The official PoD page separates read-only wallet connection from irreversible signed actions. It also warns that shallow liquidity can create large price moves and mining does not require buying BEM.
mechanicsBoundary: Mechanics explain public rules and disclosed limits; they do not predict token value, mining income or market outcomes.
officialAssetAddressesDescription: This ranked set records cumulative mint activity in the official snapshot. It does not provide an address-by-address current balance list.
officialAssetLensHoldersDescription: Official project-level count; no address-level current balances are implied.
officialAssetLensMintersDescription: Addresses observed minting over time, not verified current holders.
officialAssetLensMintedDescription: Official source units accumulated in this project snapshot.
officialAssetLensBidsDescription: Public orders observed by the official market snapshot, separate from holdings.
officialAssetLensChangeDescription: Change in the official holder aggregate versus the previous verified snapshot.
candleDescription: UTC OHLCV derived only from publicly readable third-party executed-trade records. It is not an official price feed or a complete market history.
candleNoTrades: No verified third-party trades are archived for this selection. No price is filled from an offer or prior close.
candleStale: Third-party trade archive delayed · showing last successful archive
candleBoundary: Third-party public executed-trade aggregation · non-official price · UTC buckets · empty buckets are not filled.
glossaryDescription: A bilingual quick reference for the protocol's vocabulary. Every definition summarizes publicly displayed official material and links to the page it summarizes; the official site remains the only rule source.
budgetQuoteTitle: TapeOut vs Behemoth: what does your budget buy?
budgetQuoteDescription: Walks Firsto's live public ask book for a real fillable cost, then applies the official non-pioneer weight formula. Read-only: this site never connects a wallet, buys, tapes out or claims for you — open TapeOutGo itself to actually execute.
budgetQuoteEmpty: Enter a budget and click Quote.
budgetQuoteError: Quote is temporarily unavailable; try again shortly.
budgetQuoteBoundary: Excludes gas · not a return forecast · no wallet connected
bemLeaderboardDescription: Computed independently from the official public miner index (owner → circuit list). Ranked by circuit count, not the protocol's H-weight formula — never shown as BEM/day or an official yield share.
bemLeaderboardEmpty: Leaderboard will appear after the next verified miner-index snapshot.
bemTrendingDescription: Ranks entries already in our own circuit-count leaderboard by how much they grew over the trailing 24 hours. This is not a social or discussion metric; an entry with no comparable snapshot from 24h ago is left out rather than shown with a fabricated change.
bemTrendingEmpty: No task or wallet grew over the trailing window in this snapshot pair.
bemTrendingInsufficientHistory: Not enough snapshot history yet to compute a 24h trend.
bemTradesDescription: Third-party aggregated DEX trade data, combined across every BEM pool on BSC worth tracking — the covered share and the per-pool breakdown are stated below. Not a complete record of all BEM transfers, not official protocol data, and not a trading signal or recommendation.
bemTradesCoverage: Covering {pct}% of observed 24h BEM volume across {tracked} of {total} known pools
bemTradesEmpty: No trade in the stored window has crossed the computed large-trade threshold yet.
